fusions.name: Unhurried Swing
fusions.desc: After a 1.5-second wind-up, you swing the staff through a wide cone 4 tiles long, dealing 30 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health to everything in it.

fusions.name: Drifting Prod
fusions.desc: A slow, wet prod with the staff that deals 4 damage, leaves the target [Soaked] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Drift Guard
fusions.desc: You turn the staff slowly before you, raising a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 8 seconds. Your armour rises 5% while it holds.

fusions.name: Nothing Urgent
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises 10%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
